verdict.rationale: GrowthBook publishes a pricing page with tiers: a Free plan with 'Up to 3 users' and '1 project', then Pro and Enterprise feature lists. It states 'Unlimited traffic', flags and experiments, so a PM can infer that seats and projects, not MAUs or events, drive cost. The evidence shows no actual price figures, no per-seat rate and no explicit statement of the billing unit for paid tiers. missing for 10: published dollar prices per tier, explicit per-seat/billing-unit explanation for paid plans, independent corroboration of the cost model.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
